ECHE 101.description: Introduction to engineering, with emphasis on chemical engineering. Problem-solving techniques, including the use of computer tools. Basic engineering design methods.
ECHE 101.subject: ECHE
ECHE 101.title: Introduction to Chemical Engineering

ECHE 202.description: Identification of career interests and active exploration of careers in chemical engineering.
ECHE 202.subject: ECHE
ECHE 202.title: Exploring the Chemical Engineering Workplace

ECHE 203.description: Introduction to research in Chemical Engineering, effective literature search, communication of results, lab safety, and research ethics.
ECHE 203.subject: ECHE
ECHE 203.title: Research in Chemical Engineering

ECHE 300.description: Material and energy balances in the chemical process industry. Properties of gases, liquids, and solids. Two one-hour lectures and one three-hour laboratory period devoted to problem solving.
ECHE 300.subject: ECHE
ECHE 300.title: Chemical Process Principles

ECHE 310.description: First law and second law of thermodynamics. Thermodynamic properties of single component systems. Analysis of power and refrigeration cycles.
ECHE 310.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 300.
ECHE 310.subject: ECHE
ECHE 310.title: Introductory Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics

ECHE 311.description: Mass, energy, and entropy balance analysis of chemical engineering systems; evaluation of thermodynamic property changes of pure materials; solution thermodynamics of single-phase multicomponent systems; phase and chemical reaction equilibrium.
ECHE 311.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 310, ENCP 290, CHEM 541, BMEN 290, EMCH 290 or PHYS 306.
ECHE 311.subject: ECHE
ECHE 311.title: Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics

ECHE 320.description: Fluid statics and dynamics with emphasis on chemical engineering applications.
ECHE 320.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in PHYS 211.
ECHE 320.subject: ECHE
ECHE 320.title: Chemical Engineering Fluid Mechanics

ECHE 321.description: Theory of heat transmission; mechanism, generation, distribution, and measurement; use of theory in practical equipment design.
ECHE 321.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 320 or ENCP 360; C or better in MATH 242.
ECHE 321.subject: ECHE
ECHE 321.title: Heat-Flow Analysis

ECHE 322.description: Molecular diffusion in fluids; diffusion in laminar and turbulent flow; momentum, transport analogies; interfacial mass transfer; design applications including humidification and absorption.
ECHE 322.subject: ECHE
ECHE 322.title: Mass Transfer

ECHE 372.description: Overview of the fundamental chemical aspects of materials; role of materials in applications in modern society by case studies of advances in new materials and processes.
ECHE 372.subject: ECHE
ECHE 372.title: Introduction to Materials

ECHE 389.description: Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title. May be repeated as topic varies.
ECHE 389.subject: ECHE
ECHE 389.title: Special Topics in Chemical Engineering

ECHE 430.description: Concepts of chemical kinetics, batch and flow reactors, catalysts and reactor design.
ECHE 430.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 311.
ECHE 430.subject: ECHE
ECHE 430.title: Chemical Engineering Kinetics

ECHE 440.description: Design of stagewise chemical separation cascades; analysis of binary and ternary systems; multicomponent separations, plate and column specification procedures; distillation, crystallization, extraction, and leaching.
ECHE 440.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 300.
ECHE 440.subject: ECHE
ECHE 440.title: Separation Process Design

ECHE 442.description: Basic principles of adsorption and adsorption processes including adsorbents, thermodynamics, kinetics, fixed bed adsorption and cyclic adsorption processes.
ECHE 442.subject: ECHE
ECHE 442.title: Adsorption Fundamentals and Processes

ECHE 456.description: Introduction to advanced computational tools for the analysis of chemical engineering systems. Initial and boundary value problems related to heat and mass transfer, reaction engineering, and parameter estimation.
ECHE 456.subject: ECHE
ECHE 456.title: Computational Methods for Engineering Applications

ECHE 460.description: Review of technical-report writing and presentation techniques; topics in heat transfer, fluid mechanics, and thermodynamics; verification of theoretical results and determination of design parameters. One lecture and six laboratory hours.
ECHE 460.subject: ECHE
ECHE 460.title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory I

ECHE 461.description: Continuation of ECHE 460 ; topics in mass transfer, kinetics, and process control.
ECHE 461.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 460.
ECHE 461.subject: ECHE
ECHE 461.title: Chemical Engineering Laboratory II

ECHE 465.description: Economics of chemical engineering projects related to typical corporate goals and objectives; process-flowsheet development techniques; review of shortcut design techniques; selection of profitability criteria.
ECHE 465.subject: ECHE
ECHE 465.title: Chemical-Process Analysis and Design I

ECHE 466.description: Continuation of ECHE 465 ; computer-aided design of chemical processes; written and oral presentation of a comprehensive design project.
ECHE 466.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 430, ECHE 440, ECHE 465.
ECHE 466.subject: ECHE
ECHE 466.title: Chemical-Process Analysis and Design II

ECHE 497.description: Completion of the thesis requirements for the departmental undergraduate research track. A maximum of three credits may be applied toward a degree.
ECHE 497.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: Three credit hours of ECHE 499, acceptance into the departmental undergraduate research track, and consent of instructor.
ECHE 497.subject: ECHE
ECHE 497.title: Thesis Preparation

ECHE 498.description: Reading and research on selected topics in chemical engineering. Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title. May be repeated two times as topics vary. Pass-Fail grading.
ECHE 498.subject: ECHE
ECHE 498.title: Topics in Chemical Engineering

ECHE 499.description: Individual investigation or studies of special topics. A maximum of six credits may be applied toward a degree. Advance approval of project proposal by advisor and instructor.
ECHE 499.subject: ECHE
ECHE 499.title: Special Problems

ECHE 520.description: Multi-phase pressure drop, phase contacting, flow through porous media, fluidization, mixing, and turbulence.
ECHE 520.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 320 or ENCP 360.
ECHE 520.subject: ECHE
ECHE 520.title: Chemical Engineering Fluid Mechanics

ECHE 521.description: Introduction to the use of computational fluid dynamics codes to analyze flow, heat, and mass transfer problems of practical engineering applications.
ECHE 521.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 320, EMCH 360, ECIV 360, ENCP 360, or AESP 265.
ECHE 521.subject: ECHE
ECHE 521.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics for Engineering Applications

ECHE 530.description: Intermediate concepts of chemical kinetics, batch and flow reactors, catalysts and reactor design, including non-ideal systems.
ECHE 530.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 311.
ECHE 530.subject: ECHE
ECHE 530.title: Intermediate Chemical Engineering Kinetics

ECHE 540.description: Intermediate level design of stagewise chemical separation cascades; analysis of binary and ternary systems; multicomponent separations, plate and column specification procedures; distillation, crystallization, extraction, and leaching.
ECHE 540.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 300.
ECHE 540.subject: ECHE
ECHE 540.title: Intermediate Separation Process Design

ECHE 550.description: Fundamental physical and chemical principles in mathematically modeling the dynamic response of chemical processes; feedforward and feedback control systems; design of control schemes for selected chemical processes.
ECHE 550.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ECHE 300 and MATH 242, or graduate standing.
ECHE 550.subject: ECHE
ECHE 550.title: Chemical-Process Dynamics and Control

ECHE 567.description: Reliability, availability, and fault-tree analyses, risk indices, hazard evaluation, vapor cloud modeling, toxicology, material safety classification and regulations, individual/corporate ethical responsibilities.
ECHE 567.subject: ECHE
ECHE 567.title: Process Safety, Health and Loss Prevention

ECHE 571.description: Basic principles of corrosion engineering developed from a chemical engineering approach to thermodynamics, kinetics, mass transfer, and potential theory.
ECHE 571.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 311.
ECHE 571.subject: ECHE
ECHE 571.title: Corrosion Engineering

ECHE 572.description: Industrial polymers with emphasis on their characterization and on the modeling of the major polymer fabrication processes.
ECHE 572.subject: ECHE
ECHE 572.title: Polymer Processing

ECHE 573.description: An examination of energy technologies that will enable society to move from an economy based on fossil fuels to one based on sustainable energy.
ECHE 573.subject: ECHE
ECHE 573.title: Next Energy

ECHE 574.description: Fundamental process and applications related to the broad field of combustion and energy generation including emissions control technologies.
ECHE 574.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 430.
ECHE 574.subject: ECHE
ECHE 574.title: Combustion

ECHE 575.description: Introductory overview of fundamental concepts in science and engineering of soft materials; the relation between microstructure and macroscopic behavior in a variety of soft matter systems; key applications in chemical and biomedical engineering.
ECHE 575.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in MATH 122 or MATH 141.
ECHE 575.subject: ECHE
ECHE 575.title: Engineering of Soft Materials

ECHE 576.description: A concise introductory guide to modern battery technology; overview of the electrochemical principles of batteries; operational factors of battery systems; materials for modern and emerging battery technologies.
ECHE 576.subject: ECHE
ECHE 576.title: Introduction to Battery Systems

ECHE 589.description: Course content varies and will be announced in the schedule of classes by title. May be repeated as topic varies.
ECHE 589.subject: ECHE
ECHE 589.title: Special Advanced Topics in Chemical Engineering

ECHE 700.description: Quantitative analysis of industrial chemical operations. Equilibrium relations, material and energy balances, and reaction kinetics principles are used to analyze a variety of chemical processes and systems.
ECHE 700.subject: ECHE
ECHE 700.title: Chemical Process Analysis

ECHE 710.description: Mass, energy, and entropy balance analysis of complex systems; evaluation of thermodynamic property changes of pure materials; solution thermodynamics of single-phase multicomponent systems; phase and chemical reaction equilibrium.
ECHE 710.subject: ECHE
ECHE 710.title: Advanced Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics

ECHE 719.description: Special topics in chemical engineering thermodynamics with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 719.subject: ECHE
ECHE 719.title: Selected Topics in Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics

ECHE 720.description: Theory and application of fluid flow phenomena; momentum equations, conformal mapping, empirical methods, boundary layers, dimensional analysis.
ECHE 720.subject: ECHE
ECHE 720.title: Advanced Fluid Flow Analysis

ECHE 721.description: Theory and application of heat flow phenomena; classical techniques and finite-difference numerical methods; conduction, convection, radiation, boiling.
ECHE 721.subject: ECHE
ECHE 721.title: Advanced Heat Flow Analysis

ECHE 722.description: Diffusive and convective mass transfer. Applications of the Stefan-Maxwell equations, prediction of diffusion coefficients, convective mass transport, correlations for mass transfer coefficients, and combined mass transfer and reaction modeling.
ECHE 722.subject: ECHE
ECHE 722.title: Advanced Mass Transfer

ECHE 723.description: Use of computational fluid dynamics codes to analyze flow, heat, and mass transfer problems of practical engineering applications.
ECHE 723.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: D or better in ECHE 720 or permission of instructor.
ECHE 723.subject: ECHE
ECHE 723.title: Advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics for Engineering Applications

ECHE 725.description: Rheological characteristics of viscous, elastic, viscoelastic, and plastic substances; non-Newtonian fluid flow, viscometry, and rheogoniometry; rheological equations of state; engineering applications.
ECHE 725.subject: ECHE
ECHE 725.title: Rheology

ECHE 728.description: Special topics in fluid mechanics with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 728.subject: ECHE
ECHE 728.title: Selected Topics in Fluid Mechanics

ECHE 729.description: Special topics in heat and mass transfer with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 729.subject: ECHE
ECHE 729.title: Selected Topics in Heat and Mass Transfer

ECHE 730.description: Optimum temperature sequencing. Modeling of non-ideal reactors. Theories of catalysis with emphasis on the rate of diffusion. Interpretation of experimental catalytic data and use of these data in reactor design.
ECHE 730.subject: ECHE
ECHE 730.title: Chemical Reator Design

ECHE 735.description: Fundamentals of heterogeneous catalysis, with emphasis on computational catalysis.
ECHE 735.subject: ECHE
ECHE 735.title: Heterogeneous Catalysis - Fundamentals

ECHE 736.description: Catalyst synthesis methods; experimental characterization approaches; correlating synthesis/characterization with catalytic performance.
ECHE 736.subject: ECHE
ECHE 736.title: Heterogeneous Catalysis – Synthesis, Characterization and Evaluation

ECHE 737.description: History of catalysis; industrial applications of catalysis; development of catalytic reactions from lab to pilot to production scale.
ECHE 737.subject: ECHE
ECHE 737.title: Industrial Catalysis

ECHE 739.description: Special topics in kinetics and reactor design with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 739.subject: ECHE
ECHE 739.title: Selected Topics in Kinetics and Reactor Design

ECHE 742.description: Advanced principles of adsorption and adsorption processes including adsorbents, thermodynamics, kinetics, fixed bed adsorption and cyclic adsorption processes.
ECHE 742.subject: ECHE
ECHE 742.title: Adsorption Fundamentals and Processes

ECHE 749.description: Special topics in separations with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 749.subject: ECHE
ECHE 749.title: Selected Topics in Separations

ECHE 750.description: Advanced topics in chemical process dynamics and control. Multivariate analysis, system identification, sampling, optimal process control.
ECHE 750.subject: ECHE
ECHE 750.title: Process Dynamics and Control

ECHE 759.description: Special topics in process control with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 759.subject: ECHE
ECHE 759.title: Selected Topics in Process Control

ECHE 760.description: Fundamentals of plasma confinement and fusion reaction mechanisms. Comparative study of magnetic and inertial fusion systems. Materials challenges under extreme temperature, radiation, and particle flux. Evaluation of candidate structural and plasma-facing materials for next-generation fusion reactors.
ECHE 760.subject: ECHE
ECHE 760.title: Introduction to Fusion Energy and Fusion Materials Science

ECHE 761.description: Fusion fuel cycle fundamentals and tritium breeding strategies. Isotope separation and recovery processes. Tritium handling, containment, and safety technologies. Integration of fuel cycle systems with reactor operation and materials performance.
ECHE 761.subject: ECHE
ECHE 761.title: Fusion Fuel Cycle and Tritium

ECHE 762.description: Principles of fusion breeding blanket design. Neutronics, thermal-hydraulics, and tritium breeding performance. Materials selection for structural and functional components. Integration of blanket systems with reactor operation and safety requirements.
ECHE 762.subject: ECHE
ECHE 762.title: Fusion Blanket Technology

ECHE 763.description: Modeling and simulation of fusion fuel cycle processes and breeding blanket systems. Control strategies for isotope recovery, tritium inventory, and thermal management. Coupling of neutronics, materials behavior, and systems engineering. Computational methods for performance optimization and safety analysis.
ECHE 763.subject: ECHE
ECHE 763.title: Fuel Cycle and Blanket Modeling and Control

ECHE 764.description: Analytical techniques for tritium detection, measurement, and accountancy. Monitoring of fuel cycle processes and inventories. Methods for isotopic analysis, leak detection, and environmental monitoring. Application of analytical data to fuel cycle control and regulatory compliance.
ECHE 764.subject: ECHE
ECHE 764.title: Fuel Cycle Analytical Technologies and Tritium Accountancy

ECHE 765.description: Safety principles for tritium handling and storage. Regulatory frameworks governing tritium use and transport. Global tritium supply, demand, and resource management. Nonproliferation concerns and safeguards in fusion fuel cycles.
ECHE 765.subject: ECHE
ECHE 765.title: Tritium Safety, Regulation, Supply, and Nonproliferation

ECHE 769.description: Special topics in chemical engineering design with emphasis on current research.
ECHE 769.subject: ECHE
ECHE 769.title: Selected Topics in Chemical Engineering Design

ECHE 770.description: Electrochemical engineering principles developed from thermodynamic, kinetic, mass transfer, and potential theory. Numerical analysis and design of electrochemical systems. Statistical analysis of experimental data and industrial experimental designs.
ECHE 770.subject: ECHE
ECHE 770.title: Electrochemical Engineering

ECHE 771.description: Corrosion engineering principles developed from thermodynamic, kinetic, mass transfer, and potential theory. Numerical analysis of corroding systems, statistical analysis of experimental data, and industrial experimental designs.
ECHE 771.subject: ECHE
ECHE 771.title: Corrosion Engineering

ECHE 772.description: Theory and applications of polymer systems. Structure, physical properties, rheological, and mechanical behavior of polymers. Polymerization reactions and industrial polymerization processes. Fabrication techniques.
ECHE 772.subject: ECHE
ECHE 772.title: Principles of Polymer Systems

ECHE 797.description: Individual research to be arranged with instructor.
ECHE 797.subject: ECHE
ECHE 797.title: Research

ECHE 798.description: Seminar on current topics in chemical engineering. Includes oral presentations by students on research projects.
ECHE 798.subject: ECHE
ECHE 798.title: Graduate Seminar in Chemical Engineering

ECHE 799.description: To be arranged by candidates for the master’s degree with the thesis advisor.
ECHE 799.subject: ECHE
ECHE 799.title: Thesis Preparation

ECHE 865.description: Chemical process quantitative risk analysis, consequence modeling, risk estimation, and hazards assessment; design principles including inherent safety and mitigation techniques; elements of process safety management.
ECHE 865.subject: ECHE
ECHE 865.title: Chemcial Process Safety and Loss Prevention
